explicacion.md: El **pasado continuo** describe una acción que estaba **en progreso** en un momento del pasado.
**was** va con I, he, she, it. **were** va con you, we, they.

explicacion.en: At 6 p.m. yesterday, I was having dinner.
explicacion.es: Ayer a las 6 de la tarde estaba cenando.

explicacion.md: Practica contando una anécdota real: *Yesterday at 8 p.m. I was…* Contar historias reales fija la estructura mejor que las oraciones sueltas.

ejercicios.porque: Negativo de pasado continuo con they: weren't + verbo-ing.
Una hora exacta del pasado con una acción en progreso: was + verbo-ing.

ejercicios.enunciado: What ___ you doing at 8 p.m. last night?
ejercicios.porque: Pregunta de pasado continuo con you: were + sujeto + verbo-ing.
Negativo de pasado continuo con she: wasn't + verbo-ing.

ejercicios.traduccion: Estaba viendo la tele a las nueve.
ejercicios.porque: Sujeto + was + verbo-ing, y la hora al final.
En la pregunta, were pasa al principio: Were + sujeto + verbo-ing.

ejercicios.enunciado: Une cada palabra con su traducción.

ejercicios.porque: Con it se usa was: It was raining.

ejercicios.frase: He ___ (talk) on the phone all night.
ejercicios.porque: Una acción que duró toda la noche, en progreso: was + verbo-ing.

ejercicios.texto: Last night at eleven I was reading in bed. It was raining and my parents were sleeping. Suddenly, I heard a strange noise in the kitchen. I was scared! It was my neighbor's cat.
ejercicios.pregunta: ¿Qué estaba haciendo el narrador a las once?
ejercicios.porque: «I was reading in bed»: estaba leyendo en la cama.

ejercicios.texto: Last night at eleven I was reading in bed. It was raining and my parents were sleeping. Suddenly, I heard a strange noise in the kitchen. I was scared! It was my neighbor's cat.

ejercicios.audio: What were you doing at seven this morning? I was having breakfast with my sister.
ejercicios.porque: «I was having breakfast with my sister»: estaba desayunando con su hermana.

opciones: We were waiting for the bus.
We was waiting for the bus.
We were wait for the bus.
ejercicios.porque: Con we va were, y el verbo lleva -ing: were waiting.
